summary: Iteration 2 (frontend-only). Both regressions confirmed FIXED: (1) ZERO React duplicate-key warnings on TV Guide in either timeline or box mode (688 unique epg-channel-* IDs). (2) ZERO mixed-content messages — all logos now served over https. All requested flows verified working: box grid mode (82 cards with logo, now title, progress bar, Next line), favorite toggle (star adds channel to Favorites tab's 'Favorite Channels' list, unfav removes), search tab (search-input finds channels for 'espn' and programs for 'news' under 'Upcoming Programs'; search-clear resets), settings tab (Source Status shows Channels loaded 688 / with EPG 665 / Last refreshed, settings-refresh-btn triggers refresh without error), program modal (epg-prog-* opens modal with watch/close/reminder buttons; future programs show program-reminder-btn which sets or shows 'Enable notifications' message as expected in preview), and player navigation (epg-channel-* and box-channel-* both navigate to /player?channelId=...; player-back-btn returns; surf rail has 54 surf-* items; tapping a surf-* item switches the selected channel; overlay shows channel name + Now/Next).  Video does not play in web preview — 'Unable to play this stream' overlay is expected (external HTTP HLS + no native HLS in Chromium) and per instructions was NOT counted as a failure. No new backend testing performed (per instructions).

issues: The card is a Pressable (box-channel-*), but the inner 'now title' and 'Next:' lines are also nested Pressables that open the ProgramModal. Tapping anywhere in the vertical middle/bottom of the card opens the modal instead of navigating to the player. This is functional-by-design, but the visual affordance is the whole card — consider adding testIDs like box-now-<id> and box-next-<id> on the inner Pressables so tests can target them deterministically (currently there is no testID for the Next line, so it is not directly addressable in Playwright).

react_native_issues.issue: Deprecation warning still present: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Non-blocking; carried over from iteration 1.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Add testIDs box-now-<id> and box-next-<id> on the inner Pressables in /app/frontend/src/components/BoxGrid.tsx so the 'tap Next line to open modal' path can be exercised deterministically by future tests.
OPTIONAL: Migrate pointerEvents from prop to style.pointerEvents to silence the RN deprecation warning.

server.py https logo upgrade verified — logo URLs served with https scheme, no mixed-content blocks in browser.
player.tsx replaceAsync in useEffect keyed on channel.url works: switching channels via surf-* correctly re-loads the source.
BoxGrid nested Pressable design is intentional but currently untestable for the 'Next line' path (no testID). Non-blocking.
